original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚疾控中心：100亿奈拉卫生安全基金并非专用于埃博拉防控
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚疾病控制与预防中心（NCDC）表示，联邦政府拨付的100亿奈拉用于加强该国整体卫生安全体系，而非专门用于埃博拉防控准备。NCDC总干事伊德里斯在阿布贾发布的声明中作出上述澄清，并称该资金覆盖埃博拉、拉沙热、霍乱、脑膜炎等多种公共卫生威胁的预防与应对。他同时表示，该笔资金仅约占《国家卫生安全行动计划2.0》年均需求1044亿奈拉的两成左右，资金仍显不足。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚联邦政府拨付100亿奈拉用于加强整体卫生安全体系，而非专用于埃博拉防控准备
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Federal Government released N10 billion to strengthen Nigeria’s broader health security system, not exclusively for Ebola preparedness

key_facts.fact: NCDC总干事伊德里斯在阿布贾发表声明作出澄清
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Director-General of NCDC, Dr Jide Idris, said this in a statement issued in Abuja on Monday

key_facts.fact: 该资金覆盖埃博拉、拉沙热、霍乱、脑膜炎、白喉、麻疹、猴痘及抗微生物耐药等多种公共卫生威胁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: including Ebola, Lassa fever, cholera and meningitis, among other diseases. Others include diphtheria, measles, Mpox and antimicrobial resistance

key_facts.fact: 100亿奈拉直接拨付给NCDC，而非总统埃博拉病毒病工作组
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the N10 billion was released directly to NCDC, not the Presidential Task Force on Ebola Virus Disease

key_facts.fact: 《国家卫生安全行动计划2.0》（2025至2029年）五年约需5220亿奈拉，年均约1044亿奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria’s National Action Plan for Health Security (NAPHS) 2.0, covering 2025 to 2029, required approximately N522 billion for implementation over five years

key_facts.fact: 100亿奈拉约占该计划年均成本的两成
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the N10 billion represented about two per cent of the plan’s average annual cost

key_facts.fact: 2026年10月20日NCDC实验室确认一例邦迪布焦型埃博拉输入病例，目前尼日利亚无活跃埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Bundibugyo Ebola case was confirmed in NCDC’s laboratory on Oct. 20, 2026 ... Nigeria currently had no active Ebola case

key_facts.fact: 所有已识别接触者正接受每日监测，监测将持续至最后一名接触者完成21天医学观察
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: all identified contacts were under daily monitoring ... until the last identified contact completed the mandatory 21-day monitoring period

uncertainties: 埃博拉疫情后续走向尚未完全确定，NCDC表示该国尚未脱离风险
监测期内是否出现新增病例有待观察
